'''2012 Canadian Nationals Tom Graham LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Graham]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' SWCCGtom
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
